text: ポケモンが　よりつき　にくくなる

structure.jp: よりつき　にくくなる
structure.en: become less likely to come near

patterns.name: 〜にくい
patterns.explanation: にくい added to a verb stem says the action is hard to do or does not happen easily. よりつき　にくい = 'hard to come near'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い of a describing word to く and adding なる says something becomes that way. にくくなる = 'becomes hard to'.
